title: Third special sitting of 2025
summary: This short special sitting, held outside the regular term, ran from 16:00 to 16:18 and had one main item: a committee report on appointing two members to the Anti-Corruption Commission. The Independent Institutions Committee reported that the two nominees sent by the President had both scored above 75% from committee members and that no complaints were received about them. After brief debate, members voted by open ballot to approve Ahmed Nashid and Abdulla Nashid, each passing 68-0. The next sitting was set for 6 February 2025 at 09:00.

items.title: Independent Institutions Committee report on the President's nominees for two Anti-Corruption Commission member seats (Anti-Corruption Commission Act 13/2008, Article 4(a))

speakers.name: Hussain Riza Adam
positions: As committee chair, presented the report on the two Anti-Corruption Commission nominees and how the committee vetted them.
Said no complaints were received about the nominees and both scored 75% or more from committee members.

speakers.name: Mohamed Ibrahim
positions: Said independent institutions get large budgets, staff and offices yet public trust in them keeps falling.
Argued the Majlis should set up institutions the public can trust and said recent events involving the home affairs ministry were not properly examined.

speakers.name: Husnee Mubarik
positions: Supported the committee report and said the nominees appear to have the experience and ability to do the job.
Said the government will not obstruct the commission and that it can investigate corruption in state-owned companies.

decisions: Ahmed Nashid approved by the Majlis as a member of the Anti-Corruption Commission, 68-0.
Abdulla Nashid (R. Alifushi/Fasaana) approved by the Majlis as a member of the Anti-Corruption Commission, 68-0.
Next sitting set for 6 February 2025 at 09:00.
